issues.explanation: Chapter 37 repeats the key handoff already covered in Chapter 36: Cao操 forged 徐母's letter to lure 徐庶 back to 许昌. The source Chapter 37 begins after 徐庶 has already departed and moves directly to his reception and meeting with his mother.
